tasks.label: Format motor_control
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Get-Command clang-format -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'clang-format was not found in PATH. Install LLVM and add its bin directory to PATH.' }; $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'motor_control' -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.c', '.h', '.cc', '.cpp', '.cxx', '.hh', '.hpp', '.hxx', '.inc', '.inl' }); foreach ($file in $files) { & clang-format -i --style=file --fallback-style=none -- $file.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Write-Host ('Formatted {0} files in motor_control.' -f $files.Count)
